description: Equal returned tags do not merge variants with distinct boundary obligations.
grammar:
%rule text x (r0 | r1 | r2 | r3 | r4)
%rule x A :: ($.followed-by(r0) ⟹ Mark) ∪ ($.followed-by(r1) ⟹ Mark) ∪ ($.followed-by(r2) ⟹ Mark) ∪ ($.followed-by(r3) ⟹ Mark) ∪ ($.followed-by(r4) ⟹ Mark)
%rule r0 B
%rule r1 C
%rule r2 D
%rule r3 E
%rule r4 F
